event_var.var_meaning: Overall survival status: '+' = deceased (event), '-' = alive/censored at last follow-up, 'nd' = missing/not determined

notes: Time and event variables are present in the provided supplementary data table (column headers 'dead or last follow up (days)' and 'dead').
Unit for the time variable is explicitly given as 'days' in the column header.

Mapping of '+' and '-' to deceased/alive is inferred from the header 'dead' and the dataset; sample 48 contains 'nd' for missing survival data. The paper text states 'Of 100 tumors one was lacking survival data', consistent with this missing entry.
Survival analyses described in Methods (Kaplan–Meier, log-rank test, Cox regression) were performed using these variables, consistent with an overall survival endpoint.
No other survival endpoints (e.g., progression-free survival, event-free survival) are provided in the supplied supplementary table or paper text.
Data provenance: supplementary table included in the manuscript and associated sequencing deposit GSE181582 (as noted in the paper).
